name: errorlogger-dev-proxy
description: Dev-only single-origin proxy fronting the Angular, Vue and React UIs plus the API.

scripts.all: concurrently -n angular,vue,react,proxy -c blue,green,cyan,magenta "npm --prefix ../frontend start -- --port 4200" "npm --prefix ../frontend-vue run dev" "npm --prefix ../frontend-react run dev" "node server.js"
